reason: The README describes a dsh plugin whose primary purpose is discovering model metadata from configured API hosts, normalizing pricing and capabilities, and generating catalogs and dsh configuration fragments.

summaries.zh: 从配置的 OpenAI 兼容 API 主机发现模型列表、价格和能力信息，生成标准化目录、dsh 配置片段及报告。
summaries.en: Discovers model listings, pricing, and capabilities from configured OpenAI-compatible API hosts and generates normalized catalogs, dsh configuration fragments, and reports.

capabilities: connects to configured OpenAI-compatible API hosts
reads model listings, pricing, and capability metadata
optionally sends live capability probe requests
uses API keys supplied through environment variables
writes normalized catalogs, configuration fragments, reports, and cache files
